description: PROP-E5-half-load-rollback is declared Tier 1 / required:true in verification-architecture.md line 40, but NO test exercises a bootstrap failure path. test_install_integration_darwin.py has zero tests that simulate launchctl bootstrap failing (e.g. by passing a slot whose plist would be rejected by launchd, or by monkey-patching launchctl). The rollback branch at install-proactive-plist.sh:79-86 (rm -f $PLIST + exit 6) is therefore implemented but UNVERIFIED. EDGE-E5 in the spec is explicit: 'do NOT leave a half-loaded job'. Without a test that triggers the failure, regression in this rollback path (e.g. a future refactor that drops the rm -f) will not be caught. Add a test that stubs PATH to inject a launchctl shim returning non-zero on bootstrap and asserts (a) exit code 6, (b) disk plist removed, (c) stderr contains 'launchctl bootstrap failed'.

evidence.snippet: (file contains zero references to 'bootstrap' failure, no PATH-shimmed launchctl, no assertion that disk plist is removed on bootstrap failure)
